# 10-Week Algebra Performance Snapshot

A clear way to show this class’s progress is a single upward trend line, one milestone marker at the point of strongest visible improvement, and a compact summary table for the weekly scores.

## Visualization Plan: Trend, Milestone, and Score Summary

- **Chart type:** Line chart
- **X-axis:** Week 1 to Week 10
- **Y-axis:** Score
- **Trend line:** Plot all weekly scores as one connected line to show steady improvement
- **Milestone marker:** Highlight **Week 10 (84)** as the highest score and end-of-unit milestone
- **Optional annotation:** “+22 points from Week 1 to Week 10”

## Summary Table: Weekly Algebra Scores

| Week | Score |

| 2 | 65 |

**“Student performance improved steadily over the 10-week algebra unit, rising from 62 to 84 with only a small mid-course dip before finishing at the highest score.”**
